description: Checks for <dataType> arg1 is greater than <dataType> arg2 and return the boolean result.

date.description:
Checks for date arg1 is greater than date arg2 and return the boolean result.

If a date value does not include a time-zone value, then the local time-zone value will be assigned.

dateTime.description:
Checks for dateTime arg1 is greater than dateTime arg2 and return the boolean result.

If a dateTime value does not include a time-zone value, then the local time-zone value will be assigned.

time.description:
Checks for time arg1 is greater than time arg2 and return the boolean result.

Times compare as instants on one day in UTC. If a time value does not include a time-zone value, then the local time-zone value will be assigned. To check a time of day that may wrap past midnight, use in_range<time>.
